Subject: Re: KMS residency diagram + rotation notes

Marissa / Sean / Alice — sketching the technical pieces. Key points I'll include in kms-key-flow-diagram.pdf and rotation-policy-2025.docx:
- Private (VPC/on-prem): customers may bring their own KMS (BYOK) or use Redwood-managed KMS that is region-anchored. We explicitly call out HSM residency in the diagram.
- Dedicated: keys for long-running pools are rotated quarterly; ephemeral session keys used for per-request KV cache are rotated per-instance lifecycle (minutes-hours).
- Hosted API: customer API tokens never persist in plaintext on inference nodes; data plane uses envelope encryption where we keep only wrapped keys.
- We will annotate whether any subprocessors (e.g., cloud providers for logging/monitoring) have the ability to access plaintext keys — currently none do.

Action: attaching stubs and will export a high-resolution PDF by EOD tomorrow.

Ben
Senior Systems Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
